description: This file defines a Fragment for an Android application that sets up a repeating alarm using AlarmManager. It handles menu item selection to create and schedule a repeating alarm that triggers a PendingIntent to start MainActivity every 15 seconds.

classes.name: RepeatingAlarmFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that sets up and schedules a repeating alarm to start MainActivity periodically.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment and indicates that it has options menu.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selection, specifically setting up a repeating alarm when the specified menu item is selected.
